meta.source_attribution: Data provided by CollegeBasketballData.com; ratings and calculations by The Hammer Index.
meta.methodology: Provider-verified active-roster players are ranked by projected impact. For veterans, THI begins with robust prior production and efficiency, regresses for sample reliability, translates production through the source team's adjusted strength, and adds destination and matched pedigree context. A third-party fallback may be audited for coverage, but is withheld from the product and model until current membership is verified. This research rating is not a lineup-adjusted game projection.
